question.text: Did the 40-hour week cost France combat aircraft before the German offensive? If the 48-hour legal week had stayed in force from the 27 October 1936 metalworking decree until the war, how many more combat aircraft would France have produced by 10 May 1940?

reasoning.text: Combat aircraft produced since 1 January 1936: the integral of the daily production rate, with no noise of its own. Its paired difference on 10 May 1940 answers the question.

reasoning: One contrast: keep the 48-hour legal week from the metalworking decree until the 1 September 1939 wartime regime, then follow the recorded regime. The outcome is cumulative combat-aircraft production; the paired difference on 10 May 1940 is the extra output.
